## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, what "fuzzy"
means, and how labels are normalised. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 4a specifics

- Book 4a is vol. 4, part 1: အာ – ဥတြာသေယျုံ (ā – utrāseyyuṁ). 863 PDF pages, 791 indexed.
- **Weaker than vols. 1–3, and the weakness is in the last 160 pages.** PDF pp. 1–699:
  recall 91.5%, articles located 92.9%, label + body 85.3%. PDF pp. 700–863: 79.2%, 89.0%,
  78.5%. The scan there is of a worn print: strokes broken and faint (p. 786, below).
- **Stacked ဆ under ဉ (ဉ္ဆ) is read as ဉ္စ or ဉ္ဇ.** 27 of the 38 index headwords with ဉ္ဆ are
  missed by recall (vols. 1–3: 13 of 21). The fuzzy pass places most of them.
- The first entries of each letter (အာ, ဣ, ဤ, ဥ) are set larger, with superscripts that
  OCR reads as debris ("ဤ”--", "ဤ။-"). The last pass (see vol. 1's report) places some of them;
  the four အာ entries on p. 43 and ဣ on p. 561 stay unlocated, their heads too damaged.
- No page is out of order: the weakest pages (pp. 478, 847, 786, 523) were tested against their
  neighbours' index lists, and each matches its own best. P. 845 carries only two headwords,
  both prefixes of p. 846's, so it scores 100% against p. 846's text too.

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `4a.pdf` at the native 96 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 300 | an ordinary page | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 | 12 right |
| 478 | the worst page (2 of 15 read) | 15 | 14 | 0 | 1 | 11 right, 3 not read |
| 786 | the worn last part (4 of 13 read) | 13 | 10 | 0 | 3 | 8 right, 2 not read |

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry, and no label is wrong.

- **P. 300**: all 12 at their own entry with the printed label. Five are fuzzy (the OCR misread
  the head: တာပန္တနနိဒ္ဒေသ, အာမပန္တနဝစန), and each is right.
- **P. 478**: the print has ဉ္ဆ throughout (အာဝိဉ္ဆန…), read as ဉ္စ; hence 2 of 15. 14 are at their
  entry. အာဝိဉ္ဆနရဇ္ဇု starts two lines late, at the quotation inside its own article, because its
  head line was misread; its label is lost. The unlocated one, အာဝိဉ္ဆနဆိဒ္ဒ, is the second spelling
  of the variant entry printed အာဝိဉ္ဆနစ္ဆိ(ဆိ)ဒ္ဒ; its twin is placed, but `variant_of` did not fire.
  Two labels, (ထီ) and (န), were read but not normalised: "(ထီ )" with a space, and a variant
  parenthesis in the head.
- **P. 786**: worn type. 10 of 13 at their entry. ဥဋ္ဌိတဦမိ, ဥဋ္ဌိတစောရ and ဥဋ္ဌိတဇင်္ဃ are unlocated,
  and their text stays inside the article before each. ဋ္ဌ is read as ဒ, ဋ or ဒ္ဒ in most heads.

**Labels with a lost bracket** (25 September 2026, later): a label whose ( or ) was lost, with the
[ of the analysis after it — "(ကြို [", "ထီ) [" — is now read when the reading is one the label map
knows (`label_bracket_damaged`). 86 labels gained; label + body 83.8% → 85.0%. Checked against the
typed witness (`docs/witness.md`): 84 of the 86 it has agree, against 99% for the other labels.
No label already read changed.
